text: on-entry ExecutableEntity A RunnableEntity or a BswSchedulableEntity that is triggered by a SwcModeSwitchEvent respectively a BswModeSwitchEvent with ModeActivationKind ‘entry’ is triggered on entering the mode. It is called on-entry ExecutableEntity. See also section 4.4.1.

targets.why: SwcModeSwitchEvent starts entity when mode entered
BswModeSwitchEvent starts BSW entity on entry
